# Chapter Thirteen: Under New Management

> *"Hail the new King, same as the old King"*
> — **Book of Aurtus**

Cresting the hill, the village wall stood out against the background of golden wheat as it swayed in time to the gusts of wind playing across the field.

The syncopated rhythm of a hundred boots pounded the ground behind Lord Rogan as the procession rode towards the small village that stood in the wake of the Seers keep now visible upon the craggy mountain ridge.

As Rogan looked up to regard the old stone complex a malicious smile spread across his face.

This was the dawning of a new chapter in the history of Vicor, one where he would play a key role, Rogan was now one of the twelve chosen by the Empress herself to be her hand, his newly changed coal black eyes coldly regarded his surroundings, he was her fist, her eyes and her wrath.

He had been given the northern territory within Vicor, the people would come to heel, they would serve the Empress with no complaint and no objection he vowed, a malicious smile spreading across his face.

He rode atop the large black horse, his midnight robe and heavy cowl pulled down, hiding those black eyes and the obsidian symbols engraved over his entire body.

Rogan felt the power that coursed through him, it was like nothing he had felt before, his previous abilities mere parlor tricks to what he was now able to accomplish.

He had been reborn, an acolyte to his Mistress, a weapon, a force forged to serve the Kingdom. He caught sight of a shadow in the brush and reaching out he could sense one of the wraiths that had been assigned to him.

The failed experiments now turned vicious creatures were weapons to be used against the people, to ensure their loyalty and to inspire fear,

Rogan no longer considered them failures but a new soldier, already her guards were working to grab up more who had shown signs of the gift to alter them, either they would become acolytes, soldiers or wraiths.

By the time she was done there would be no power on this planet that could stand against her he thought, the smile spreading. “Lord Seer” came a voice from behind him breaking Rogan from his thoughts.

Turning he coolly regarded Captain Postric as the man came to ride next to the New Lord Seer, Postric was a small man standing only five foot five he was now coming into the latter part of middle age his once lush brown hair had thinned greatly now showing off the balding area on top coupled with the grey streaks made him look older Rogan thought.

His Captains uniform was impeccable and aside from the slight bulge of the paunch from his mostly sedentary existence he looked the part of the Captain of the guard contingent.

Rogan smiled at the other man, the smile however did not come across as friendly and the old Soldier recoiled a bit before recovering, it was not lost on Rogan and he reveled in the reaction for a moment.

Postric was a pain but he was detailed and kept the troop running smoothly, Rogan appreciated the man like a good tool, one you thought about when it was needed for a job and then simply put away and forgot when it was done.

“Captain, what can I do for you?” Rogan asked keeping his tone casual and offering the other man a smile. Postric returned it though his was nervous, but not recoiling, since the Empress had given Rogan his rebirth the mundane soldiers eyed him and his brethren fearfully or with curiosity.

They had seen what the new Seers could do and they were right to be fearful, his kind, the kind who could make there will manifest were meant to lead those who couldn’t surely these men could see that, Postric was a lot of things Rogan thought, but he was at least smart enough to know he was in the presence of his betters.

The other man did his best not to make eye contact with Rogan and that amused him, though he was not sure why maybe it was the same kind of joy an alpha gets when the members of his pack defer to him, he thought.

“Lord Seer, since we are approaching the town, I wonder if it would not be smart to ensure you have a security contingent, we are not sure how the town will take the change in leadership” he said but Rogan caught the nervous undertone of the statement.

Was he afraid something would happen to Rogan or was he simply afraid that if Rogan disagreed with him, he would set him on fire or worse he mused still regarding the man?

Postric was getting more nervous by the moment and Rogan realized he had simply been staring at him, for how long he wondered and then shook it off, it didn’t matter.

There was a big picture, one someone like Postric would not understand, it was Rogan’s destiny to be here, to be this and he would fulfill it, he no longer doubted, no longer felt bad when Mundane’s fell at his or other hands. He was protecting humanity, defending the race as a whole by removing the obstacles that would try to stand against his Empress and her plans.

“No we will be fine, lets ensure the soldiers secure the town, we might have to make a few examples if they decide to protest the changeover, but not too many, we will need the commoners to work, the Empress needs resources if she is to march on the Northern and Eastern Territories” he answered.

Postric gave him a nod as he fell back to the troops leaving Rogan along with his thoughts once again. They rode past the small village making their way to the keep on the hill, as they passed Postric gave orders dispatching troops and Rogan watched as a forty-man contingent fast marched towards the town.

They were ordered to ensure no unrest would occur during the transition period. Rogan also knew if they received any trouble, they were to make an example of them. He had already received word of more than one village that had been set ablaze at contesting the will of the Empress, word would spread, and the people would learn quickly that any resistance would be answered with death he thought smiling as he watched the commoners coming out of their homes and businesses to watch the contingent of soldiers entering the town.

This was a time that the people needed to be brought together, force would be required but they would quickly defer, he knew the power of fear on a population and he would use it to ensure his territory was kept in line he thought. This was how you saved humanity, you first had to bend them to your will, they did not know why they served nor did they need to, but they would serve.

These people would not understand why the Empress would do this, they would fear the change and fear the hand of their new overseer, this hand being rougher then the last, but Rogan did not do it out of a hatred for these people, no in fact he loved the people who made up the kingdom.

He did it because he knew, like the Empress the only way to move humanity forward in a single direction, in order to save them was to rule over them and sometimes that took the carrot and other times the stick, he mused smiling to himself at his clever analogy.

Making their way up the hill, the old Keep growing closer the details of the old stonework crystalizing, Rogan could appreciate the old complex, but now was not the time to appreciate architecture, now was the time to show the people of his territory that a new age had come, and this one required total obedience of his subjects.

As they came closer to the large gates Postric barked out orders, soldiers entered the market square surrounding the castle quickly making their way down the streets and alleyways, taking up station, ensuring that anyone out on the street was told to go back to their homes and sometimes encouraging them.

As Rogan watched four people who complained were put down as the brilliant blue flashes from pistols ended their lives, those left moved quickly running not walking to safety.

Rogan stood witness as the guards quickly cleared the streets. The light beginning to fade over the small courtyard as the sun set, the lamplighter was the only one left, pushed by the guards to finish his duty, the streets lighting one lamp at a time as the man turned the screws bringing the crystals together within the housing. The soldiers also broke out small lanterns and as Rogan watched the streets began to light once again, as they continued to check the small alleys next to shops ensuring that the Market square was locked down.

He smiled; the guards were nothing if not efficient he thought moving towards the entrance of the large stone castle that stood as the seat of power for the Lord Seer of Turen.

Dismounting his horse, he slowly made his way up the long set of stone steps, the two guards eyeing him nervously as he approached, to their credit neither had moved as the soldiers had entered the market, but Rogan could hear the clanging of the alarm bell sounding and knew soon Galen Bor’s guards would soon be on their way.

The guards crossed the ceremonial poleaxes they held, the silver of the axe heads shimmering in the reflected lantern light.

Rogan stopped just inches from the weapons and looked askance at the two guards, throwing back the hood he spoke, allowing the shock of his visage to add to the weight of his words. “Who are you to prevent me entrance, my orders come from the Empress herself, stand aside lest you feel my full wrath” Rogan summoned as much menace and authority as he could put in the words.

The guards stared in shock at the obsidian eyes of the man who now bade entrance into their lords castle, but the two guards stood firm despite the fear.

Rogan had to give them credit for that. “Sir, we have orders that no one is admitted without the approval of our Lord Galen Bor” stammered one of the guards.

Rogan smiled at the man who seemed to flinch at the expression “Go get your lord then soldiers, I would have words with him” Rogan stated and stood there waiting as the guard sped off retreating further into the castle as he went to find Lord Seer Galen Bor.

Rogan stood silently surveying the land as the moonlight gave a dim view of the surrounding farmland. This would be his, his to rule for the Empress, he reaffirmed his vow that this territory would be an example, a beacon for the others to look up to, but in order to do that he thought people would have to die and examples would have to be made, neither bothered him.

“My Lord, can I help you” came a reedy voice from the entrance breaking Lord Rogan from his thoughts. Turning, he found himself facing a slight, unassuming man in a gold robe standing next to the guards.

Rogan smiled and he could see the small man’s eyes go wide at the sight of him as he lifted his head, the lamp light highlighting his features and exposing his face.

The small obsidian glyphs marring his skin glinted against the light, making them impossible not to see. “I am Lord Rogan, I am of the chosen twelve of the Empress and I have been sent here by her command, you will take me to see Galen Bor NOW” he commanded.

The group of Galen’s subjects stepped back at his words. Rogan was tired of waiting, tired of these pitiful creatures getting in the way of his destiny and he took an aggressive step forward, calling forth the power, the glyphs began to heat against his skin as power coursed through them doubling and redoubling as it amplified through the runes, with a quick swipe of his hand he released the built up energy, the three servants slamming against the side of the stone entrance, Rogan could hear a satisfying crack as bones broke.

Walking by the three unconscious forms he barely gave them a second look as he stepped into the large foyer of the keep. Making his way across the hall he took a moment to appreciate the architecture of the old building.

This place would serve him well he thought.

He came to the large double doors of the main room and nodding to his own guards who had followed him in, they stepped forward pushing the large doors open. Revealing the keeps spacious throne room.

Rogan smiled as he walked through, his gate full of authority and confidence as he came to stand in front of the old man sitting atop the throne of judgement.

The seat of the Lord Seer’s power. “Who dares enter this chamber without invitation or permission” Galen said his voice annoyed and haughty as he looked down his nose at the young man in the long black robes.

Galen glanced at the two guards seeing the tunics with the gold lioness crests emblazoned on their chest. “You come by order of the Empress?” he asked, and Rogan just nodded.

“There is respect and decorum when entering the realm of one who rules for the Empress or are you too young to know this” Galen chided leveling a severe gaze at the younger man.

Rogan said nothing, just stood regarding the old man. Yes, he thought there would need to be examples. A malicious smile spread across his face and Galen upon seeing this took a figurative step back, his body pressing into the back of the red velvet padded throne, suddenly the air of authority he exuded diminished in Rogan’s presence.

Such an old, scared frail man Rogan thought as he stared at the Lord Seer, ex Lord Seer he corrected himself, taking the sealed letter from within his robes he stepped up the four stone steps bringing him to the same level as the throne and relished in a small amount of joy as Galen tried to shrink away as he approached him.

Rogan pushed the sealed parchment towards him and with some trepidation Galen took it, breaking the seal he carefully read the letter his face turning white as he read it a second time.

“She cannot do this to me, my supporters won’t stand for it” he stammered but there was no conviction in his words, Rogan could see it in his face. Galen knew he was done.

“It’s a new age Galen, after tonight it won’t matter what your supporters think or want, the old ways are being replaced, this is a new dawn for the world, and you my friend” he began as Rogan extended his arm, energy began to gather and the familiar warmth of the ruins was almost comforting, then as he pushed more power through them, the heat began to increase causing him to wince.

With an exhalation of relief, he unleashed the power lifting the Lord Seer off of the throne. The look of shock was amusing and held only for a moment before the frail old man slammed down onto the stone floor with a bone jarring grunt and slid a few feet stopping against the muddy boots of Rogan’s soldier contingent. “are no longer relevant” he finished.

Rogan yelled to the guards barking a quick series of orders as they dragged the semi-unconscious Lord Seer outside to the courtyard.

Rogan followed close behind as he came out onto the dais, he called Captain Postric over “Gather the people” he said and for a moment Postric looked confused but the glare that Rogan gave him had the man turning on his heels and barking new orders to his soldiers.

The residents were herded out of the buildings, all of them sharing a similar bewildered look as they moved out into the common area in front of the stairs of the old Keep. It took close to an hour for the soldiers to check every building and ensure that all the residents were gathered.

Soldiers began to hang new lanterns to ensure that the courtyard was well-lit for the spectacle to come. Rogan stood patiently watching the crowd and seeing the fear and confusion.

They now waited to see what would happen and feared that they might be next he reflected as he stood there silently while Galen had come to now held in the center of the courtyard by two soldiers, he protested loudly to anyone who looked his way.

Rogan could almost smell the man’s fear as if he knew what was about to happen, he thought and did his best to suppress the smile that tried to spread across his face, now was not the time for frivolity he thought maintaining a serious composure.

Once the soldiers had nodded towards him letting him know they were all there Rogan stepped forward towards Galen and his two guards. As he did the crowd began to quiet.

“Today, is a new day your Empress calls upon all her subjects to serve. The coming days will not be easy, as we move towards bringing this land into a united kingdom, your sons will become soldiers, those of you with skill will be conscripted to build weapons, ammunition and supplies for the coming wars, this territory will be a beacon of service to our Empress, work hard and you will have my gratitude, complain or refuse to work” he stated and then nodded to the two guards who let Galen go and backed off, the old man just standing there looking bewildered for a moment.

Rogan could see the calculation in his face he did not know if he should stand and argue or run and again Rogan withheld another smile as he once again gathered power.

“You will join your old Lord Seer” he finished and with a thought the old man burst into flame. The crowd gasped in unison as they watched the old Lord trying to beat the flames from his body, but after only a few moments, his body crumpled to the ground, a pile of cooking meat for everyone to see.

Rogan nodded to the guards who began to usher the crowd back towards their homes. Except one, the woman stood in the shadow, the erect posture of a professional soldier silhouetted against her now dead master.

Starish looked on seeing the smoking remains of what was left of Lord Galen as he continued to smolder, left there like yesterday’s garbage. With a grimace she turned and disappeared into the shadow, unseen by the guards.

Rogan entered the keep ignoring the shouting as the guards continued to herd the common people back into their homes. Postric posting guards, ensuring the keep was protected in case the common rabble decided to retaliate, but knowing after that demonstration not one would dare.

Walking into the main hall Rogan crossed the large room and climbed the stairs to the large throne.

Turning he settled into the ornate chair, appreciating how comfortably it fit him. Thinking about the people, remembering the faces that peppered the crowd, the look of shock and horror that spread quickly as there old leader burned, Rogan had hoped his example was enough to show them how serious he was in dealing with those who did not follow orders, he felt a pang of guilt for the old man, you are doing this to save all of humanity, what is the death of one old man when balanced against that he thought justifying his actions that night.

“Lord Rogan, what are your orders?” came a tentative but familiar voice from the doorway and Rogan turned to regard Loric standing there at the doorway, seeming unsure whether to enter or not.

With a smile he waived his young assistant in and noticed the look on the young man’s face.

“Loric, what’s wrong?” he asked and for a moment the young man didn’t speak. With a motion of his hand he urged him on.

“Why did you kill that old man Lord?” he whispered and then seemed to shrink a little as if he himself would suddenly burst into flames. Loric had seen Rogan use his powers since returning from the tower, though he didn’t think the young man was quite used to the site he reflected.

The new Lord Seer stood and came down to stand next to his young assistant “Loric, we are saving the future of our species, one death measured against such a goal is nothing. By making an example of the old Lord Seer we save others from the same fate” he said gently putting his arm over the young man’s shoulder.

“Things will get better, the Empress’s plans will bring this land together and we, as a people will ensure our safety under her rule, you will see” Rogan finished trying to reassure Loric.

“Now, get settled in, we have a big day tomorrow. Report to me in the morning and we will begin the task of putting this territory to work for the coming war” he said patted Loric on the shoulder.

The young man nodded, but didn’t look at Rogan at all, instead shuffled off deeper into the keep looking for the rooms. On reflection he probably should have had the young man make up the Lord Seer’s room before going to bed. Rogan thought of sleeping on the same cloth the old man had and cringed a bit.

The next morning Rogan awoke still sitting upon the large throne, squinting against the bright sunlight as it filtered in through the windows.

Standing he stretched his back attempting to work out the kinks as he listened to the bustling of the soldiers dressing and preparing for the day.

Rogan smiled, it would be a big day he thought walking out of the large room and across the hall to the dining area, opening the door he found two servants setting the table under the watchful eye of one of the soldiers.

Rogan nodded to him as he entered sitting down, he realized he was starving and caught the attention of one of the serving girls. “I will have eggs and bacon” he ordered, and the young woman scurried off. It was good to see that Postric already had the hall servants working, he did not need the distraction, nor did he need Loric distracted, today they would receive the nobles and they would not be happy with the Empress’s directive he reflected.

The servant brought breakfast and Rogan dug in with gusto, today was the day he set this territory right he mused smiling through a forkful of eggs.

Loric entered the room a short time later, the young man looked like he hadn’t slept, his blonde hair had barely been brushed Rogan observed.

The young man was having a moral dilemma at least that is what Rogan thought. They were doing good work, the sacrifices they made now would secure the safety of the race he mused, but how did he convince the young idealist youth of that.

Rogan knew he would have to rely heavily on this young man in the coming weeks, he would be Rogan’s right-hand handling most of the details of running the territory just as he had when Rogan was chancellor he reflected, but he couldn’t do that if the young man winced every time Rogan had to make an example of someone to ensure that the others stayed in line.

He considered the young man, trying to figure out a way to get through to him but nothing came to mind. Coming over to Rogan he could see the troubled look on his face. “What is it Loric, you’re not still upset about Galen Bor are you?” he asked concerned this would become something that would force Rogan to replace him and that would be a shame.

He was a reliable employee and those were hard to come by. “What?” he asked looking at Rogan confused for a moment and then he understood what he was asking him.

“No my Lord, word came from the Empress we are to begin searching for the one who has returned as soon as we get settled, she is stating it is of the utmost priority, she also tells us the Wardens have gone missing from the keep and we should be vigilant, if we should see any then we are to arrest them and find out where the rest have gone. Finally, the Empress has seen to the Lord Reagent, the Messengers and Aurtus’s keep, they are now in our hands and the Lord Reagent is very cooperative” he finished as Rogan digested the information.

He knew about the one she was searching for, the man who had come from the stars had been something of a fascination for the Empress and she had placed a lot of stock in him, Rogan had already begun to hatch a plan to find out more if there was anything to be known, the Warden’s disappearance was disturbing, they were not to be trifled with and if they were truly gone then the entire organization had gone to ground.

Not knowing the location of the Wardens would come back to haunt him he thought as he mentally prepared for the coming day, it was something they would have to discover, but not right now, now they had more pressing matters.

“Loric, lets schedule the nobles starting later this afternoon, I want messengers to their homes, and they are to report here, its mandatory, I need to speak to Captain Postric immediately as well”.

Loric nodded “But my lord, they have already gathered, they are waiting outside, apparently word of the fate of Galen Bor has traveled fast, I didn’t want them leaving so I had dispatched the soldiers early this morning” he stated and Rogan smiled, the young man was efficient he reflected, he thought for a moment and then nodded to himself “Good make them wait, I will speak to Postric and then you can show them in, ensure the room is lined with soldiers before you do, I wish them to understand that any wrong step might be there last” he stated, Loric scratching a few notes on parchment.

Rogan smiled as he looked forward to his conversation with those lords and ladies, like his father, the men and women who thought them better because of there lineage or money were about to truly understand what power was.

Loric nodded and walked out of the dining room. Rogan continued to eat, smiling as he thought about the reaction of the nobles once he explained the new policies of their Empress.

Postric came through the door a few moments later, coming to rigid attention, he saluted, his uniform was spotless as usual, Rogan wondered how the man managed to keep himself so clean all the time.

He quickly dismissed the thought as he motioned for the captain to join him at the table. Postric did, sitting across from Rogan he sat with a rigid back, looking as if he was maintaining the posture of attention while sitting.

Rogan nodded at the man appreciating his professional demeanor, He had not been sure what to think of the small pudgy soldier with the delicate features when the Empress had assigned him as the captain of his guard.

But Captain Postric had proven himself to be reliable and detail oriented on this entire trip. “Captain, I need information, you are to find informants intown and foster them, I need to know if a man or woman was seen, someone who was a stranger to this place who might have come through anytime within six months, it’s of the utmost importance I find this out” Rogan said still picking at the remnants of the plate of food in front of him.

Postric nodded slowly to his Lord “At once Lord, what do we do if we find out he or she was here?” he asked, and Rogan smiled attention to detail he thought continuing to nod approvingly at the captain.

“Finding this person is of the utmost importance Captain, but do not approach him, if you are able to discover his whereabouts, come get me at once, I will deal with him, do not fail Postric, you would not enjoy what failure brings” he finished leaving the threat unsaid but Postric was no fool, he knew he served at the pleasure of both the Empress and Rogan and if one was not happy, he would not have to worry about looking for a new job.

The Captain nodded getting up from the table and bowing slightly to the Lord Seer, “My Lord” he said leaving Rogan alone with his thoughts.

It Is going to be a good day Rogan thought smiling as he stepped away from the table and walked from the dining room as the servants scrambled to clear his plate behind him.

He listened to the staff as they scrambled around, the distinct sounds of silverware and china as they moved across each other.

A place for everyone and everyone in their place he thought moving to the receiving room.

He stood there a moment appreciating the craftsmanship of the throne of adjudication, the place where the seer dispensed justice for the territory.

On that chair he was the voice of the Empress, and his dictates were taken as high royal writ. This was the seat and symbol of his power he thought smiling as his eyes wandered over the carved legs as Lions stretched up to meet the arm rests that had been covered in the finest red velvet and silk.

Rogan took his place upon the throne taking a steadying breath and enjoying the moment of quiet. It was time for the next step in the Empress’s plan for the territory he thought as he watched the soldiers enter the room, walking along the wall and lining up along it.

Loric entered a moment later looking around and then at Rogan, giving his Lord a small bow.

He had wondered how best to accomplish his task, finally deciding on bringing them all in together.

Calling his assistant over he whispered his orders and watched as Loric hastily walked out of the entrance.

A moment later Loric Stepped into the room and stood aside as a group of twenty well-dressed men and women entered the receiving room.

“I present to you the new Lord Seer of Turen, one of the chosen twelve of the High Empress of Vicor, His most high, Lord Seer Juric Rogan” Loric announced in a loud authoritative voice.

All of them looked stoic and reserved but Rogan could see the nervous energy and fear radiating off of the entire group, they had heard of the previous night’s events, as they had entered Turen small groups of soldiers were dispatched to the estates of these highborn, these privileged of Turen to ensure they wouldn’t get the idea that leaving the territory was an option.

Rogan smiled at the group and motioned them forward after today he thought it wouldn’t matter what they did, but first he had to deliver the Empress’s edict.

The group came to stand in the center of the chamber. Despite the fear they stood tall and proud some even in defiance.

Rogan didn’t mind he understood it and leaning forward on the throne he smiled at the group. “Thank you for honoring my request to see you this morning, I understand it has been a trying transition” he began knowing they had been escorted by soldiers the choice to come taken out of their hands.

“My Lord Seer, I object to this heavy-handed tactic that you are employing, we are not only great supporters of the Empress, but we also carry much influence in the court, this will not go unpunished” came a deep baritone from within the group.

Rogan continued to smile and nodded “Lord Criswell, I understand your position, however you might not have heard, since those you pay in the capital to keep you informed of the goings on are now dead, all of your support, well no longer exists, those lords who advise the Empress and who finance her are having a meeting very similar to this one right now, I assure you my lord, it doesn’t matter what you report” Rogan said, the smile never leaving his face “My word is law”.

“Now, the reason you have been called in today is simple, this kingdom for too long has suffered under political games meant to undermine the Empress’s vision, your short sighted nature and power games have gone on too long and have caused too much damage and delay” he began.

Rogan could see the wide eyes and shocked looks of the lords and ladies but he pressed on anyway “Your land, money and businesses, are at this very moment being seized, they are now property of the crown, and administrators will be appointed to ensure the smooth transition, your titles have been stripped, and your homes and estates have been taken to serve the Empress’s needs” he finished and still the smile remained.

“This is an outrage; you cannot do this” came one voice. “I will take this straight to the Empress, how dare you try to usurp our titles” came another and Juric Rogan made a quieting gesture with his hand.

“I can do this and I have” he said simply “Now the only issue I have, is what to do with you, I mean look at you all” he stated shaking his head “You are too old to put to work, so I could let you go” he began and the group, went quiet, he could see the hope in a few of them and his smile widened. “But, I’m afraid you would try and return with soldiers to retake what you mistakenly think is yours so, goodbye” he said and with that the soldiers around the edge of the room leveled resin rifles and in an instant blue flames shot across the room and into the small group of nobles, the site was beautiful as the blue glowing crystals that were grown for ammunition entered the body, exploding into Vulcan hot blue flames.

Rogan watched as light erupted from mouths and eyes incinerating organs and bone, the bodies dropping one by one until no one was left standing.

Lord Seer Juric Rogan sighed, so much to do today, it was time the people were put to work he thought and nodded, the lieutenant by the door exiting into the courtyard and motioning to the soldiers who began to collect the commoners of Turen, leading them in lines to the fields and mines where they would now work for the common good, as they left their home, other soldiers went house to house, collecting valuables, and money that could be sold or used to barter for weapons or supplies.

As the villagers were led out of the keep, they met with another group being escorted from the lower village, the two lines in complete contrast to each other, one was of the young able-bodied men of Turen, the other the older citizens, the young being herded to carts, they would serve as soldiers in the Empress’s coming campaign, while the others served by ensuring enough materials to feed the war machine.

Rogan smiled with pride at his soldiers efficient handling of the village and keep, this land will become a shining example of service to my Empress he thought staring out the window as the sun danced in the sky, a small smile of contentment spread across his face.

Loric entered the room bowing low and waited a moment while Rogan enjoyed the silence. Once he was ready the new Lord Seer waved at his assistant and beckoned him over.

Loric hurried to the bottom of the throne, “My Lord, Postric has found some information and he wishes to speak to you, do you have time for him?” he asked and Rogan leaned forward a glint of excitement in his eye, “Show him in” he said with anticipation.

Loric hurried over and opened the door, A moment later a smiling Captain Postric entered the large room and walked with confidence towards the throne.

Rogan’s smile widened as he took in the other man’s demeanor, he had news and from the look of it, Rogan was going to like it.

“Speak Captain” he said waiving off the attempted bow, Postric straightened still smiling.

“Sir, as you requested, we questioned a few of the villagers about a stranger and it turns out one was here, in fact he lived in this very village. On a small farm, his name is Marcus he told everyone he was a traveler from across the sea my Lord” he began, and Rogan shot up, could it be. Is it possible he had found that which the Empress so fervently sought, oh if this were to be true the Empress would be overjoyed, he thought?

Rogan would be the first among her chosen and that thought excited the young man.

He looked expectantly at the captain, holding his breath, he waited for him to finish, the captains smile fell a little.

“Sir, apparently there was an altercation with Lord Bor’s collectors and they were killed, along with the woman he had been residing with, the man then disappeared, we have little information on where he went” he continued and Rogan’s own smile faded as anger began to well up within him, but the Captain quickly hurried to finish before he could incur the wrath of this very powerful mage.

“My Lord, it turns out he had a close friend in town, the Messenger Veric, also he spent some time visiting the Mage at the local Crystal Smith shop, I request permission to bring them in and question them” he said, and Rogan calmed a little.

“Yes Captain, I don’t care what you have to do, get them to talk. I want to know where this man went, I need to find him” he finished and with a wave sent the captain off.

Rogan stared out the window, a gleeful predatory glint shone in his eye as the smile returned.

He would find this man, he would deliver him to his Empress, and he would be celebrated as a hero, the cost did not matter, he would bathe the land in blood to find this Marcus and would not stop until he was in his possession.
